hero.subtitle: Designed for high-performing organizations. Fluso runs within your secure boundaries, with SSO, audit logs, custom retention, and no proprietary APIs in the pipeline.

capabilities.title:
Designed to be
personalised.
capabilities.subtitle: Fluso fits how you already operate: connectors to your systems, skills your team codifies, and deployment matched to your compliance posture.

connectors.title:
Wire Fluso to
your stack.
connectors.desc: 500+ canonical connectors plus the systems behind your firewall. REST, GraphQL, SOAP. We write the schema mapping. You keep auth in your hands.

skills.title:
Codify how
your team works.
skills.desc: A skill is a saved instruction Fluso runs the way you taught it. Plain English, versioned like code, promoted team-wide with permissions and audit.

deployment.title:
Pick where
data lives.
deployment.desc: Three deployment modes, one product, full feature parity. Pick the perimeter that maps to your compliance posture.

confidential.title:
Workloads no one
can read. Including us.
confidential.subtitle: Enterprise tenants run inside hardware-isolated trusted execution environments on Prem AI's confidential compute. Memory is encrypted while in use, and remote attestation lets you verify the runtime before any plaintext enters.

closing.title:
Run Fluso inside
your perimeter.
closing.subtitle: Tell us about your stack and your compliance posture. We will come back with a deployment plan, SSO and audit-log scope, and the current SOC 2 Type II attestation.
